data.description:
Your mission

We're looking for a Senior Conversion Design Analyst who is genuinely both things: a designer who digs into data, and an analyst who designs. You decide with evidence. You will frame real user problems based on qualitative and quantitative data, design a part of our product, form a view about what should change, build the experiment that tests it, and analyze the results yourself.

You will sit inside the product delivery team that focuses on user growth, working closely with the person accountable for that part of the business and with the engineers building it. And you will not be doing it alone: You join a group of Conversion Design Analysts across the company who work the same way and hold each other's standards.

English is our working language. German matters here too: You will be designing flows that German-speaking users read.

Concretely, you will:

  • Design experiences grounded in real user needs and real neighbourhood life. Your job is to design flows and screens that are highly usable and intuitive and that earn their place by adding measurable value, not just because we can build them.
  • Frame the real problem before solving it. Dig into quantitative and qualitative data until you find the actual question underneath the ask. Then make it explainable and actionable. A well-framed problem is half the battle
  • Design, run the experiment, read it honestly and decide what comes next. Define a testable change, get it instrumented properly, and analyse the outcome. Then use what you learned to frame the next question. That includes reporting the tests that did not work, and designing the next step.
  • Talk to neighbours. Experiments tell you what happened, not what people needed. You will spend real time with the people who use this, because you cannot A/B test your way to understanding somebody.
  • Direct AI, and spend your judgment where it counts. AI produces a lot of our first-pass design. You will brief it, push back on it, and hold the quality bar, so your own hours go to the thinking a model cannot do.
  • Argue for cutting things. Adding is easy. You will help decide what earns its place and what should be removed, and be willing to make the case for less.

Your profile

  • You practice product design and analytics. You might come from an analyst background and bring a love of design and design thinking, or vice versa.
  • You have run experiments end to end and know how to move from one to the next. Setting up the hypothesis, designing strong variants using our design system, choosing the right metrics to track, analyzing the results and then making a clear call on how to continue: ship it, kill it, or iterate.
  • You have technical know-how and experience in setting up and evaluating experiments in an A/B testing tool, constructing the needed dashboards for the problem space you are working on.
  • With sufficient data literacy, you get your own numbers through SQL query. You work with raw data to dig up insights and spot opportunities, without waiting for someone else to pull it for you.
  • You have statistical literacy. You don’t need to be able to run R, but you understand what Bayesian vs. frequentist is about and why you do a power analysis before launching an experiment.
  • You care about craft and are attentive to details. You can tell the difference between good enough and actually good and you design experiences people do not have to think about.
  • You present your work clearly, defend your decisions when challenged, and are comfortable in front of a crowd.
  • You are fluent with AI tools. This role allows you to have more control and impact through both design and analysis, but to do this well you'll need to leverage (and at times extend) our AI enablement stack
  • Excellent English skills for working in our international team.

To apply, include a cover letter explaining why this role and why now and if your background doesn't tick every box, tell us how you'd bridge the gap. Alongside it, share a portfolio that shows your work through its impact, at least one project walked through end to end: the hypothesis, what you designed, the result, and what you took from it. Show us how you used data to move your thinking forward, and where experimentation shaped what you built. If you can't share a portfolio due to an NDA or the nature of your work, a detailed cover letter walking through a project in the same way is fine.

Nice to have

  • Experience with a marketplace, community, classifieds, or other network product.
  • Strong German, or the confidence to design in it with support.
  • Experience building or maintaining parts of a design system.
  • Comfortable writing SQL without AI assistance.
  • You have basic dbt knowledge.

What we offer

  • Hybrid work model combining office and remote days
  • A meaningful job – we're creating a great product with real added value for the community
  • Work in a cheerful and experienced team that exchanges ideas and learns from each other
  • Insights into the entire work process of our social startup and the nebenan.de foundation
  • Responsibility and great opportunities to actively contribute
  • Your nebenan.de SpenditCard – you'll receive an additional income of 35 Euros per month, which you can use for things of your choice
  • 30 days of vacation per year – we also offer the possibility of workation models and a sabbatical
  • A workplace in Berlin-Kreuzberg and regular events like yoga or Lunch & Learn sessions.

If we’ve captured your interest, apply now and let us know why you’re the perfect fit for the job!

data.description:
Neural Frames is a leading AI music video generator, turning any song into a fully produced music video in minutes. We're bootstrapped, profitable, and generating more than $5M in annualized revenue. Our ambition is to build a category-defining company that helps tens of millions of audio creators visualize their content and promote it online. The next target is a $15M run rate.

We're hiring our first product engineer focused on growth. You'll own our marketing pages and the surfaces that turn attention into revenue: free tools, landing pages, signup, onboarding, paywalls, and pricing. You'll also ship on the core product itself. Wherever the biggest lever is, that's where you build.

This is a builder role. You'll ship production code daily, look at the results, decide what to test next, and be one of the people most directly responsible for taking us from $5M to $15M and ultimately to $100M.

As a profitable company, there is no VC drama. We are a small, ambitious group of people striving to build something creators love.

Tasks

  • Own our marketing pages: build, maintain, and continuously improve the landing pages and site experiences that bring people into Neural Frames, and keep them fast, high-converting, and visible in traditional search, Google AI Overviews, and AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity
  • Turn our free tools into real product entry points, where users get immediate value and then continue into Neural Frames without losing their song, lyrics, artwork, or progress
  • Run conversion experiments across the whole funnel: landing pages, calls to action, signup, onboarding, paywalls, packaging, and pricing
  • Ship on the core product when that's where the growth lever is, especially product-native loops: shareable creations, templates, embeds, referrals, and public pages that give creators a reason to spread Neural Frames for us
  • Run programmatic SEO experiments without creating low-quality pages, index bloat, or content that exists only for search engines
  • Build lifecycle experiments tied to real product behavior: activation, abandoned projects, paywall recovery, feature discovery, re-engagement
  • Make sure our Conversion Tracking is set up correctly
  • Own growth measurement and data quality across PostHog, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and our backend payment data: build funnels and dashboards you can trust, investigate unexpected movements, and turn them into decisions

Requirements

  • You're a product engineer who can independently ship production experiences with React, Next.js, and TypeScript, and you sweat the details that make pages convert: speed, layout, copy, polish
  • You're comfortable moving into backend and data work when necessary. Our backend is written in Python, and you can work with APIs, SQL, event data, and attribution logic
  • You think like a marketer as much as an engineer: you have real opinions about headlines, page structure, and pricing pages, and you'd rather be measured on signups and revenue than on tickets closed
  • You think through the complete funnel. A page that ranks is not a win if visitors don't activate, pay, and stick around
  • You understand experimentation: hypothesis, primary metric, guardrails, and a decision threshold defined before the test goes live
  • You have strong product and editorial judgment. You build useful experiences for humans rather than filling the internet with generic AI-generated pages
  • You use AI tools as a genuine extension of how you work, with a high bar for accuracy, originality, and brand quality
  • You have high agency: you identify the bottleneck, gather the evidence, ship a solution, and communicate results without waiting for a perfectly specified ticket
  • You're based in Berlin and can join us in the office at least four days per week

Bonus points:

  • You've personally built something that produced meaningful organic or product-led growth: a startup, a free tool, a programmatic SEO engine, or growth ownership at a product company. We care more about attributable revenue than impressive traffic screenshots
  • You know technical SEO well: crawling, indexing, structured data, internal linking, canonicalization, and safe migrations

Benefits

VSOPs & Profit Sharing. Bi-weekly team lunches, regular team events, an annual summer offsite, learning & development support, productivity tools, a one-time headphone budget, Deutschlandticket, and a €5,000 referral bonus.

neural frames is dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and supportive work environment that brings people together from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Our strength is in our differences. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants as we're committed to promoting a culture of opportunity for all.

data.title: Information Security Specialist (m/w/d)

data.description:
Remote in Deutschland · Vollzeit · €85.000–100.000 + 1,0–1,5 % Anteile

Warum es diese Stelle gibt

Infinos ist eine der größten Telemedizin-Plattformen für medizinische Abnehmtherapie in Deutschland. Wir machen einen mittleren 7-stelligen Jahresumsatz, sind profitabel und haben bis heute kein Investorengeld genommen. Zwei Gründer, ein Team von rund 8 Leuten, tausende Patienten, die wir jeden Monat behandeln.

Jetzt bereiten wir unsere Seed-Runde vor. Ich bin Jan, der technische Gründer, und bis heute der einzige Vollzeit-Entwickler. Ich suche die Person, die diesen Job von mir übernimmt: den Stack verantworten, Features bauen und deployen, das Team koordinieren und später mit mir das Engineering-Team aufbauen.

Was du machst

  • Unseren Stack verantworten: ein TypeScript-Monorepo mit 11 Apps und 32 Packages. Next.js, tRPC, Prisma mit Postgres, Trigger.dev für Hintergrundjobs, eine Expo-App für iOS und Android

  • Features von der Idee bis zum Deploy bauen, meistens mehrere pro Tag. Ein Großteil des Codes entsteht bei uns mit AI Coding Tools

  • Pull Requests reviewen, auch die, die Agenten geschrieben haben.

  • In Produktionsdaten nachschauen, wenn etwas nicht stimmt, und mit KI-Hilfe die Ursache finden.

  • Deployment und Infrastruktur: GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, Postgres, Secrets, Monitoring.

  • Unsere Arbeit mit Agenten weiterentwickeln, zum Beispiel Agenten in der CI oder automatisierte Reviews.

Deine ersten 90 Tage

  • Woche 1: erster eigener Deploy in Produktion.

  • Monat 1: du reviewst alle PRs und kennst das Monorepo.

  • Monat 3: du bist für die Infrastruktur verantwortlich, hast bereits mehrere größere Features allein geshippt und sagst uns, was wir als Nächstes bauen sollten.

Wen wir suchen

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung mit produktionsreifer Software, ein guter Teil davon in TypeScript. Du hast schon Verantwortung für Deployments und Infrastruktur getragen.

  • Du arbeitest täglich mit KI-Coding-Agenten und kannst zeigen, was du damit gebaut hast. Das fragen wir im ersten Gespräch ab.

  • Docker, CI, Cloud oder Kubernetes hast du schon betrieben. Infra-Spezialist musst du nicht sein.

  • Du willst Entscheidungen treffen und dafür geradestehen.

  • Deutsch oder Englisch fließend.

Hilfreich, aber nicht nötig: Expo, Vercel AI SDK

Was wir bieten

  • €85.000–100.000 Fixgehalt, je nach Erfahrung.

  • 1,0–1,5 % virtuelle Unternehmensanteile (VSOP). Im ersten Gespräch rechnen wir dir vor, was das bei verschiedenen Exits wert ist.

  • KI-Tooling ohne Budgetgrenze: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Frontier-Modelle.

  • Remote in Deutschland, regelmäßige Teamtreffen.

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit beiden Gründern.

  • Wenn das Team wächst, wirst du Head of Engineering.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub, Hardware nach Wahl.

So bewirbst du dich

Kein Anschreiben. Schick uns hier über join: einen Link zu etwas, das du gebaut hast, ein paar Sätze, warum diese Rolle, und wie du KI in deinem Arbeitsalltag nutzt.

Wir antworten innerhalb von 3-5 Tagen. Dann:

  1. 30 Minuten Videocall mit mir. Ich erzähle dir, was wir bauen, wie die Zahlen aussehen und warum es diese Stelle gibt. Du erzählst mir, was du zuletzt gebaut hast und was du suchst. Danach wissen wir beide, ob es Sinn ergibt weiterzumachen.

  2. 60 Minuten technisches Gespräch. In der ersten Hälfte führst du mich durch ein Projekt, das du gebaut hast: Architektur, Entscheidungen, was du heute anders machen würdest. In der zweiten Hälfte öffne ich unser Monorepo, zeige dir, wie wir arbeiten und deployen, und du stellst Fragen. Kein Live-Coding, kein Algorithmen-Quiz.

  3. Ein bezahlter Probetag. Du bekommst ein echtes Ticket aus unserem Backlog und eine Entwicklungsumgebung mit Testdaten. Du arbeitest mit deinen eigenen Tools, so wie du es sonst auch tust, und am Ende reviewen wir deinen PR gemeinsam. Den Tag bezahlen wir als Freelance-Auftrag.

  4. 30 Minuten mit der Geschäftsführung über die Erwartungen beider Seiten: was wir in den ersten Monaten von dir brauchen, was du von uns brauchst, und wie wir zusammenarbeiten wollen.

  5. Schriftliches Angebot - vom ersten Gespräch bis hierhin peilen wir unter zwei Wochen an.

Bringe Technik in große Bauwerke im Stahlwasserbau!

Hinter beeindruckenden Objekte wie Schleusen, Wehranlagen oder Schiffshebewerken steckt weit mehr als nur Stahl und Beton – erst die Elektrotechnik macht sie funktional. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Als Projektleiter im Bereich Elektrotechnik gestaltest du bei uns komplexe Anlagen im Stahlwasserbau und bringst innovative Technik in wasserbauliche Anlagen. Von der ersten Planung über technische Berechnungen bis hin zur finalen Umsetzung begleitest du Projekte, die wirklich etwas bewegen – im wahrsten Sinne des Wortes.

Wenn du Lust hast, Elektrotechnik mit spannenden Infrastrukturprojekten zu verbinden und gemeinsam mit einem erfahrenen Team nachhaltige Lösungen zu entwickeln, dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Aufgaben

Darauf kannst du dich bei uns freuen

  • Planung anspruchsvoller Anlagen
    Du planst und konstruierst elektrische Anlagen im Stahlwasserbau – etwa für Schleusen, Wehranlagen oder Schiffshebewerke – und begleitest die Projekte von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung.
  • Technische Berechnungen und Auslegung
    Du dimensionierst Energienetze und sorgst durch fundierte Berechnungen dafür, dass Anlagen effizient, sicher und zuverlässig funktionieren.
  • Steuerungs- und Beleuchtungstechnik
    Von der Planung moderner Steuerungstechnik bis hin zu detaillierten Beleuchtungsberechnungen bringst du deine elektrotechnische Expertise in verschiedene Bereiche der Anlagenplanung ein.
  • Planung und Dokumentation
    Du erstellst Leistungsbeschreibungen und Leistungsverzeichnisse als Grundlage für die Umsetzung der Projekte und sorgst für eine vollständige und nachvollziehbare technische Dokumentation.
  • Technische Zeichnungen und Planung
    Du erstellst, bearbeitest und optimierst technische Zeichnungen sowie Pläne, Grundrisse, Schnitte und Ansichten. Dabei führst du auch Zeichnungskonvertierungen und Anpassungen bestehender Unterlagen durch.
  • Präzise Planung bis ins Detail
    Mit deiner strukturierten Arbeitsweise stellst du sicher, dass alle Planungsunterlagen aktuell, vollständig und technisch sauber ausgearbeitet sind.

Qualifikation

Mit diesem Profil bist du die ideale Ergänzung für unser Team

  • Du hast ein Studium der Elektrotechnik erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder verfügst über eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Erfahrung im Planungsumfeld technischer Anlagen gesammelt und bringst Interesse an anspruchsvollen Infrastrukturprojekten mit.
    Erfahrung im Stahlwasserbau ist kein Muss – wichtiger ist uns deine Neugier auf Technik, die große Wassermengen bewegt und steuert.
  • Normen, Richtlinien und technische Regelwerke schrecken dich nicht ab – im Gegenteil: Du arbeitest gerne damit und behältst auch im Regelwerksdschungel den Überblick.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und lösungsorientiert und behältst auch bei komplexen Aufgaben den Überblick. Gleichzeitig bist du ein Teamplayer, der gerne gemeinsam mit Kollegen und Projektbeteiligten an optimalen Lösungen arbeitet.
  • Ein sicherer Umgang mit den gängigen Office-Anwendungen rundet dein Profil ab.

Benefits

Das macht uns besonders

Wir sind überzeugt: Ein guter Arbeitsplatz besteht nicht nur aus spannenden Aufgaben, sondern vor allem aus einem starken Team und einem Umfeld, in dem man sich wohlfühlt.

  • Ein Team, das zusammenhält
    Bei uns arbeitest du in einem motivierten und erfahrenen Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt. Offene Kommunikation, gegenseitiger Respekt und ein unkompliziertes Miteinander gehören für uns ganz selbstverständlich dazu.
  • Projekte, die wirklich etwas bewegen
    Unsere Projekte im Stahlwasserbau sind technisch anspruchsvoll und alles andere als alltäglich. Dadurch erwarten dich abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben, bei denen du dein Fachwissen einbringen und weiterentwickeln kannst.

    Dank flacher Hierarchien und kurzer Entscheidungswege können Ideen schnell umgesetzt werden. Deine Vorschläge finden bei uns immer ein offenes Ohr.
  • Arbeiten in moderner Umgebung
    Helle Büroräume, moderne Ausstattung und Parkplätze direkt vor der Tür sorgen für einen angenehmen und unkomplizierten Arbeitsalltag.
  • Arbeiten, wie es zu deinem Leben passt
    Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice geben dir den Freiraum, deinen Arbeitsalltag individuell zu gestalten.

In Deiner täglichen Arbeit stehst Du im engen Austausch mit unseren anderen Teamverantwortlichen. Sie liefern Dir das Fachwissen, Du übersetzt es in Prozesse und Systeme. Gemessen wirst Du an Deinen zentralen Kennzahlen, und machst diese Größen für die gesamte Organisation transparent. Mittelfristig baust Du Dir das Team auf, das Du brauchst, sobald die Potenziale größer werden als das, was Du allein liefern kannst. Wer in welchem Tempo dazu kommt, entscheidest Du datengetrieben.

Ihr Profil

Du bist technisch versiert und arbeitest hands-on mit KI. Du hast hast bereits Systeme und Automatisierungen gebaut, die in echten Geschäftsprozessen laufen. Du musst nicht aus dem Immobilienumfeld kommen, das Fachwissen liefern unsere Expert:innen, Du lieferst die technische Architektur.

Du bist daten- und prozessaffin. Du erkennst Muster in Daten, denkst in Inputs und Outputs und kannst manuelle Abläufe so zerlegen, dass sie automatisierbar und integrierbar werden. Du bist generalistisch, Du kannst Dich in ein Thema reindenken, indem Du Dir erklären lässt, wie es heute manuell gemacht wird, und daraus eine elegante technische Lösung entwickeln.

Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und kannst priorisieren. Du wirst von allen Seiten Wünsche bekommen und Du musst entscheiden können, was zuerst gebaut wird. Du kommunizierst in beide Richtungen souverän, sowohl mit Fachverantwortlichen über deren Prozesse als auch über deren technische Umsetzung. Du bringst Führungspotenzial mit. Du startest allein, baust aber mittelfristig ein Team auf. Du musst keine zehn Jahre Führungserfahrung mitbringen, aber den Willen, ein Team aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln.

Deutsch sprichst Du fließend, unsere internen Prozesse, Kunden und externen Partner laufen auf Deutsch.

Warum wir?

Wir wachsen schnell und wir wollen es so tun, dass jeder einzelne Vorgang schneller, präziser und reibungsloser läuft als heute. Genau dafür suchen wir Dich.

Du übernimmst nicht ein bestehendes Team mit operativer Tagesverantwortung, die liegt bereits in starken Händen.

Senior Sales Manager - Media (m/w/d)

data.description:
About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Your Mission

As a Frontend Engineer at Hawk, you will build and maintain the user interface of our agentic AI Investigation Agent. This is the product where compliance analysts configure AI workflows, watch autonomous investigations run, and review, question and act on what the agent concludes.

The frontend is a modern TypeScript monorepo made of a host application and a growing set of independently deployable microfrontends. These remotes are designed to be built once and used in two places: our new shadcn/ui-based Investigation Agent and our existing Material UI-based Case Manager. Your job is to understand this codebase deeply, keep it healthy, and ship new features with care, from the component level all the way to how it is built and deployed.

What You'll Work On:

  • Features: Build product features end to end in React and TypeScript, such as workflow graph editors, investigation timelines, data-heavy tables and dashboards that make agentic AI output understandable for analysts.

  • Microfrontends: Develop and maintain Module Federation remotes, keep remote/host contracts stable, and make sure features fit into both the Investigation Agent and the MUI-based Case Manager.

  • Design system and data layer: Contribute to our shared shadcn/ui + Tailwind component library (documented in Storybook), and consume our Python/FastAPI backends through OpenAPI-generated clients with TanStack Query and Router.

  • Build, test and deploy: Work in a pnpm + Turborepo monorepo with GitHub Actions CI, Vitest and Playwright tests, and deployments to AWS including per-PR preview environments.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with Product, UX, backend engineers and Data Science, and use AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor as part of your everyday workflow.

Your Profile:

  • 3–5 years building and maintaining production React applications, with strong TypeScript and modern React skills (hooks, composition, performance, complex state and forms).

  • Clean frontend architecture: you structure code around features and clear boundaries. You keep UI components presentational and reusable, put data fetching and business logic in hooks and typed API layers, and keep server state separate from local UI state. You prefer composition, small focused components and strict typing, and you treat cross-module contracts as an API.

Operating from your desk, you will monitor real-time operational performance, dynamically allocate workforce capacity, and coordinate with on-site teams to keep every site running at peak efficiency.

Your mission is simple: turn live data into immediate action. By anticipating bottlenecks, balancing labor across sectors, and keeping operations aligned, you’ll ensure every order is processed seamlessly and delivered on time.

Why this role is exciting

  • Impact at scale: Directly influence labor allocation and operational output across Germany’s Fulfillment Centers from a single, centralized control tower.

  • Real-time decision-making: Work in a dynamic environment where live data translates directly into high-impact operational adjustments.

  • Smart logistics & tech: Drive performance at the intersection of automation, WMS platforms, and data-driven workforce management.

  • True ownership: Anticipate disruptions, resolve bottlenecks early, and maintain optimal operational flow under pressure.

What you’ll do

  • Control the flow: Monitor real-time dashboards and direct automated labor flow by assigning team members across individual sectors through central control tools.

  • Balance capacity dynamically: Adjust workforce distribution and shift plans on the fly in response to fluctuating order volumes and site priorities.

  • Drive operational KPIs: Track CPT (Critical Pull Time), SLAs, idle time, and sector efficiency—identifying bottlenecks early and executing timely interventions.

  • Keep teams aligned: Partner closely with Area Managers, Operations Managers, and on-site shop floor teams to execute adjustments and maintain consistent operational standards.

  • Optimize continuously: Analyze shift performance, identify recurring process gaps, review SOP compliance with site teams, and contribute feedback for next-generation labor management tools.

What we are looking for

  • Relevant operational background: Experience in dispatch, logistics, operational planning, supply chain, e-commerce, or fulfillment (experience with automated warehouses or labor scheduling is a plus).

  • Control-tower mindset: Strong ability to connect the dots across complex, fast-paced operations and make confident, data-driven decisions under pressure.

  • Tech confidence: Comfortable steering operations using real-time dashboards, WMS platforms, and automated labor allocation tools.

  • Strong language & communication skills: Very good English for daily operations and reporting, combined with strong Romanian language skills for direct, clear coordination with shop floor teams.

  • Shift availability: Willingness to work in a 3-shift system from Monday to Friday.

  • Structured & proactive approach: A problem-solver who anticipates disruptions rather than just reacting to them.

What we offer on top of your base salary

  • Daily meal allowance: An additional €9.00 tax-free meal allowance for every working day

  • Daily travel allowance: An additional €5.00 daily subsidy toward your commuting costs

Im Jahr 2027 möchten wir wachsen. Damit das auch personell funktioniert, braucht es Recruiting, das schnell, verbindlich und nah an Kandidat:innen und Fachbereichen arbeitet. Dafür suchen wir für diese Phase Unterstützung für unser People-&-Culture-Team.

Was dich erwartet

Als Junior Recruiter unterstützt du Alex, unseren Talent Acquisition Manager, im operativen Recruiting und übernimmst von Anfang an direkten Kandidatenkontakt. Gemeinsam arbeitet ihr an unterschiedlichen Positionen – von der ersten Ansprache über Interviews bis zur Begleitung des gesamten Bewerbungsprozesses.

Dabei wirst du nicht einfach ins Tagesgeschäft geworfen: Du lernst unsere Recruiting Best Practices kennen, bekommst unser Vorgehen im Candidate Management vermittelt und baust Schritt für Schritt dein allgemeines Recruiting-Know-how aus.   • Enge Abstimmung mit Hiring Managern und internen Ansprechpartnern

Worauf es in dieser Rolle ankommt

Du musst noch kein vollständig ausgebildeter Recruiter sein. Wichtiger ist, dass du Recruiting grundsätzlich verstehst, gerne mit Menschen arbeitest und Lust hast, schnell Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Gut passt die Rolle zu dir, wenn du bereits erste Berührungspunkte mit HR oder Recruiting hattest – zum Beispiel durch Studium, Praktikum, Werkstudententätigkeit oder eine erste Junior-Position.

Hilfreich sind insbesondere:

  • Grundlegendes Verständnis von Recruiting und HR

Recruiting von Anfang an praktisch lernen

Du arbeitest direkt mit Kandidat:innen, führst Gespräche und bekommst schnell Einblick in echte Recruitingprozesse statt nur administrativ zu unterstützen.

data.description:
Über GetMentioned

GetMentioned.com ist die SEO-Plattform für Sichtbarkeit in Google und KI-Suchen. Agenturen, Inhouse-SEOs und Marketing-Teams erreichen mit uns Top-Rankings für ihre wichtigsten Suchbegriffe und werden in ChatGPT, Perplexity & Co. genannt. Dafür kombinieren wir unsere eigene Content Engine TextRocket mit einem Online-PR-Marktplatz mit über 100.000 Publishern.

Deine Rolle

Du verantwortest das SEO und die KI-Sichtbarkeit von getmentioned.com. Du entscheidest, welche Themen wir besetzen, welche Seiten wir bauen oder verbessern und was als Nächstes passiert. Daneben betreuen wir noch einige wenige SEO-Kunden, denen du bei Fragen und in der strategischen Beratung zur Seite stehst; der Aufwand dafür hält sich in Grenzen.

Dein Impact

Wir verkaufen Sichtbarkeit in Google und KI-Suchen. Jede Seite, die du nach vorn bringst, bringt Besucher und Anfragen. Und wenn ChatGPT nach dem besten Anbieter für Linkaufbau gefragt wird, soll die Antwort GetMentioned lauten.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du legst fest, welche Suchbegriffe und Fragen wir besetzen, in Google und in KI-Suchen.

  • Du planst die Themen, schreibst Briefings und eigene Texte und überarbeitest bestehende Seiten, mit unserer Content Engine TextRocket und KI. Wo es sinnvoll ist, steuerst du Freelancer.

  • Du kümmerst dich um Onpage und Technik: interne Verlinkung, Seitenstruktur, Meta-Daten, strukturierte Daten, Indexierung und Ladezeit, gemeinsam mit unserem Entwicklungsteam.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini und die AI Overviews GetMentioned nennen, wenn es um Backlinks, Brand Mentions und Digital PR geht.

  • Du planst Links, Erwähnungen und Digital PR für die eigene Marke über unseren Marktplatz.

  • Du beobachtest Search Console, Rankings und KI-Erwähnungen und weißt jede Woche, was sich bewegt hat und warum.

  • Du beantwortest Fragen unserer wenigen SEO-Kunden und gibst ihnen strategische Empfehlungen.

  • Du bringst deine SEO-Praxis in die Plattform ein. Du testest neue Funktionen und sagst dem Produktteam, was Kunden wirklich brauchen.

  • Du verantwortest das SEO von GetMentioned.com gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung.

Woran wir deinen Erfolg messen

  • Das eigene SEO hat einen festen Takt: Mindestens 5-10 neue oder überarbeitete Inhalte pro Woche.

  • Getmentioned.com wächst in Google: Die organischen Klicks laut Search Console steigen von Quartal zu Quartal.

  • GetMentioned wird in KI-Suchen genannt: Wir prüfen jeden Monat ein festes Set an Fragen in ChatGPT, Perplexity und den AI Overviews. GetMentioned wird bei immer mehr davon genannt.

  • Aus Besuchern werden Kunden: Die Registrierungen aus der organischen Suche steigen von Quartal zu Quartal.

  • Kunden bekommen schnell eine Antwort: Fachliche Kundenfragen sind innerhalb eines Werktags beantwortet und landen nicht mehr beim Geschäftsführer.

Was du allein entscheidest

  • Welche Themen und Seiten als Nächstes kommen und wer sie schreibt.

  • Was auf getmentioned.com veröffentlicht und überarbeitet wird, innerhalb unserer Markenregeln.

  • Freelancer beauftragst du ohne Rückfrage, innerhalb eines Monatsbudgets, das wir gemeinsam festlegen.

  • Welche SEO-Empfehlung du unseren Kunden gibst.

  • In welcher Reihenfolge du deine Arbeit angehst, solange alle Termine halten.

Unsere Werte

Nach diesen vier Werten stellen wir ein, geben Feedback und entscheiden, wer mehr Verantwortung bekommt.

  • Ergebnisse. Jede Aufgabe hat ein Ergebnis und einen Termin. Deine Zahlen kennst du, bevor jemand fragt. Wann und wo du arbeitest, entscheidest du, solange du erreichbar bist. Bewerbungen mit Track-Records sehen wir gern.

  • Schnell entscheiden. Fragen sind am selben Tag geklärt. Eine gute Entscheidung heute ist uns lieber als eine perfekte nächste Woche.

  • Direktes Feedback. Wir sagen sofort, was gut war und was nicht, in beide Richtungen. Feedback setzt du beim nächsten Versuch um.

  • Verantwortung vom ersten Tag. Wer ein Problem sieht, kümmert sich darum. Was zweimal von Hand passiert, baust du beim dritten Mal als festen Ablauf oder als Prozess mit unserem Dev Team oder KI.

Wen wir suchen

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre SEO in der Praxis, in einer Agentur oder Inhouse.

  • Du hast schon eine Website selbst nach vorn gebracht und kannst die Zahlen dazu zeigen.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit der Search Console, mit Sistrix oder Ahrefs und mit einem Content-Tool wie Surfer.

  • Du schreibst gute Texte selbst mit KI und erkennst, wann ein KI-Text noch nicht gut genug ist.

  • Du priorisierst selbst. Aus zwanzig offenen Themen ziehst du das eine, das jetzt zählt.

  • Du denkst selbst. Bei einem Problem, das du noch nie gesehen hast, stellst du die richtigen Fragen, bevor du loslegst.

  • Du willst Feedback. Sagt dir jemand, was nicht funktioniert hat, machst du es beim nächsten Mal besser und diskutierst es nicht weg.

  • Du nutzt KI jeden Tag und hast Erfahrung in Claude Code / Codex und evtl. auch bereits eigene SEO Tools gebaut

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, Gutes Englisch und Wort und Schrift.


Erfahrung mit KI-Sichtbarkeit, im Linkaufbau oder mit B2B- und SaaS-Websites ist ein Vorteil.
Track-Record bei eigenen Projekten und Kundenprojekten ist ebenfalls ein Vorteil.

Ehrlich kommuniziert vorab

  • Die 25 Stunden verteilst du auf alle fünf Werktage, zum Beispiel vormittags. So bist du für das Team und unsere Kunden jeden Tag erreichbar.

  • Wer lieber zuarbeitet oder SEO als Checkliste abarbeitet, wird bei uns nicht glücklich.

Was wir bieten

  • 25.000 bis 32.000 € brutto im Jahr bei 25 Stunden pro Woche, je nach Erfahrung. Das entspricht 40.000 bis 51.200 € auf Vollzeitbasis.

  • 25 Stunden pro Woche, remote.

  • Eine eigene SEO-Plattform mit Marktplatz, Content Engine und Daten, die du für unsere eigene Marke voll nutzen kannst.

  • Zugang zu Sistrix, Ahrefs und Surfer sowie KI-Tools und eigenen SEO Abläufen, mit denen wir arbeiten.

  • Direkter Draht zum Geschäftsführer mit mehr als 10 Jahren SEO Erfahrung. Enorme Entwicklungs-Möglichkeit, sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich.

  • Dein nächster Schritt: Wächst die Arbeit, kannst du mehr Stunden übernehmen und die Leitung SEO und AI Search mit eigenem Team aufbauen - auch international.

So läuft die Bewerbung

  1. Bewerbung. Dein Lebenslauf inkl. Website, die du nach vorn gebracht hast, mit den Zahlen dazu. Beantworte in deiner Bewerbung in genau drei Sätzen: Warum willst du genau diese Stelle? Wie genau du diese Anleitung befolgst, ist schon Teil der Auswahl.

  2. Gespräch per Video mit all unseren und Deinen Fragen.

  3. 2 Arbeitsproben & Live-Arbeit. Details folgen in der jeweiligen Runde.

data.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Company

DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt are one global team building the future of local commerce. Our products power millions of interactions between consumers, merchants, and couriers every day, in cities around the world. Together, we're combining global scale with deep local understanding to deliver what's next. In this role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across all three brands.

About the Team

This role sits within the Global Internal Communications team, a high-impact group focused on engaging and connecting with DoordDash, Deliveroo and Wolt's most important audience: our employees. This role will specifically support the International business (Deliveroo and Wolt) in Europe and the Middle East (EMEA).

We are responsible for leading employee communications centred around our company-wide strategy, business goals, and financial results to ensure employees understand the company's near- and long-term vision. This team works cross-functionally with key business stakeholders, touching every corner of the organisation.

About the Role

Reporting to the Senior Manager, International Internal Communications, you will provide support across the Deliveroo and Wolt businesses including being the key internal comms point of contact for our EMEA country teams, working on change and issues communications, and partnering on content creation and relevant internationally focused projects. 

This role is ideal for someone with between 5-10 years of communications experience who is experienced in working with multiple stakeholders in fast paced but sometimes ambiguous environments. You will partner closely with the Senior Manager to translate complex or evolving information into clear, effective communications for employees.

Day to day you'll be:

  • Acting as the main internal comms point of contact for Deliveroo and Wolt (EMEA) country teams and regional communications managers

  • Building and maintaining the community of internal communicators across the EMEA footprint, sharing best practice and editorial guidance and keeping consistency with international IC standards.

  • Supporting crisis and issues communications across EMEA, partnering with the Senior Director and Senior Managers 

  • Providing change management comms support, partnering with the change management comms lead and people team on delivery.

  • Creating content to support company level events, such as all hands

  • Leading on analytics and measurement for such events for the international internal comms team, working closely with the digital channels team.

  • Operating effectively as part of a global team partnering with the international business.

We're excited about you because…

  • You have a strong (5yrs +) track record of communications experience.

  • You work well with multiple stakeholders across countries and brands, and can build and sustain a network of communicators.

  • You thrive in fast paced, sometimes ambiguous environments, and stay effective when situations move quickly.

  • You can translate complex or evolving information into clear, effective communications for employees.

  • You are comfortable supporting crisis, issues and change communications.

  • You are comfortable with data, and can turn engagement reporting into insights.

  • You are flexible and can turn your hand to a wide range of comms projects and topics  

Next steps

  • Step 1: Apply before Mon 26th October

  • Step 2: Screening with our recruitment team

  • Step 3: Panel interview with hiring manager and team lead

  • Step 4: Written test and final interview

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

Als Projektassistenz (wie wir die Position intern nennen) begleitest du unsere Gutachten und Online-Auktionen operativ von der Vorbereitung bis zum Abschluss. Gesucht wird jemand, der auch bei vielen parallelen Vorgängen strukturiert bleibt, offene Themen konsequent nachhält und gerne Verantwortung für einen vollständigen Prozess übernimmt.

Von der Gutachtenerstellung und den Vorbereitungen einer Auktion bis zur finalen Auszahlung begleitest du den vollständigen operativen Ablauf und übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle im Tagesgeschäft.

sovero GmbH, ein renommiertes Unternehmen in der Technologie- und Informationsbranche mit Sitz in Frankfurt am Main, sucht Softwaretester:in (m/w/d) in Vollzeit zur Verstärkung unseres Teams.

Mit unseren engagierten Mitarbeitenden entwickeln wir erfolgreich Softwarelösungen für die digitale Verwaltung von Dokumenten sowie deren Bearbeitung mittels Workflow-Prozessen. Moderne Projektfelder verbinden wir mit fast 50 Jahren Erfahrung und einem zukunftssicheren Firmenhintergrund.

Aufgaben

Unsere Mission ist nicht weniger als die vollständige Umstellung der Verwaltungen auf digitale Geschäftsprozesse. Dafür brauchen wir Menschen, die Freude an Innovationen haben. Als Softwaretester:in leistest Du einen entscheidenden Beitrag zur Qualität unserer Lösungen: Mit Deinem Blick fürs Detail und Deinem Qualitätsanspruch stellst Du sicher, dass die gemeinsam im Team entwickelte Software zuverlässig und fehlerfrei bei unseren tausenden Anwendern ankommt.

EIN SPANNENDES AUFGABENFELD

In dieser Rolle des/der Softwaretesters:in bist Du Teil unserer Qualitätssicherung und übernimmst eine zentrale Aufgabe bei der Sicherstellung der Softwarequalität. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf dem manuellen Testen: Du führst bestehende Testszenarien durch, entwickelst neue Testfälle und passt diese kontinuierlich an neue Anforderungen an. Dabei sorgst Du für eine strukturierte und nachvollziehbare Testabdeckung unserer Anwendungen.

Ein Teil Deines Aufgabenbereichs ist die enge Mitarbeit in einem agilen Scrum-Team. Dort begleitest Du die Entwicklung neuer Features aus Testsicht, überprüfst implementierte Funktionalitäten und leitest eigenständig Testfälle aus User Stories und fachlichen Anforderungen ab. Im Rahmen des Test-Driven Development (TDD) wirkst Du außerdem daran mit, frühzeitig passende Testszenarien zu definieren und zu etablieren.

Darüber hinaus arbeitest Du aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung unserer QS-Prozesse mit. Perspektivisch besteht die Möglichkeit, Dich im Bereich der Testautomatisierung weiterzuentwickeln, insbesondere im Umfeld von UI-Tests.

Qualifikation

DAS ERWARTEN WIR VON DIR

  • Erste Erfahrung im Software Testing, idealerweise im manuellen Testen
  • Fähigkeit, Testszenarien und Testfälle eigenständig aus User Stories und Anforderungen abzuleiten und zu erstellen
  • Strukturierte Vorgehensweise bei der Durchführung und Dokumentation von Tests
  • Verständnis für Softwareentwicklungsprozesse, idealerweise im agilen Umfeld (Scrum)
  • Teamfähigkeit sowie eine sorgfältige und analytische Arbeitsweise
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Von Vorteil sind außerdem:

  • Kenntnisse in der Testautomatisierung, insbesondere im Bereich UI-Tests (z. B. Playwright)
  • Erfahrung mit GitLab
  • Grundlegendes technisches Verständnis
  • Erfahrung im explorativen Testen

Benefits

DAS KANNST DU VON UNS ERWARTEN

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
  • Überdurchschnittliche Vergütung
  • 30 Urlaubstage (nach Probezeit)
  • Mobiles Arbeiten mit einem Mix aus Home-Office-Anteil (nach Probezeit)

Who are we?

It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks. This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents. All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS!

What will you do?

As Cybersecurity Project Manager (m/w/d) based in Germany, you will lead the delivery of projects that help protect organisations and the people who depend on them across Europe. You will bring together NVISO specialists in security operations, automation, Detection Engineering, Cybersecurity Architecture and incident response to turn customer ambitions into delivered security solutions.

You will manage implementation, integration and improvement projects from kick-off through acceptance and handover to the teams responsible for ongoing operations. You will keep scope, timelines and dependencies aligned, and make sure customers and colleagues know what has been agreed, what comes next and where a decision is needed.

You will work closely with Business Development, senior management and technical experts, organising their contributions and following commitments through. Your cybersecurity knowledge will help you ask informed questions and connect technical dependencies to delivery decisions. Experts retain technical ownership; you bring the people, plans and decisions together to deliver the project.

Typical responsibilities include:

· Managing implementation projects from kick-off to acceptance, with clear scope, milestones, dependencies and responsibilities across NVISO teams and customer stakeholders;

· Securing commitments from capability leads and organising timely support and decisions from Business Development, senior management and technical experts;

· Leading customer meetings and delivery reporting, aligning expectations and communicating progress, risks and next steps in language suited to each audience;

· Managing risks, issues and scope changes, agreeing achievable plans and escalating decisions with clear options and their impact on delivery;

· Tracking effort, budget consumption and forecast-to-complete, and reporting deviations and proposed actions to the senior manager, who retains P&L ownership;

· Coordinating expert validation, customer acceptance and operational handover, then closing the project with follow-up actions assigned and lessons captured.

What we are looking for

  • You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states or the Austrian citizenship;

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent professional experience;

  • Experience managing multi-team cybersecurity or IT implementation projects, covering planning, dependencies, risks, scope changes and delivery reporting;

  • Sound understanding of security operations, detection and response, automation and cybersecurity architecture, sufficient to discuss dependencies with experts and explain their delivery implications;

  • Experience tracking effort, budgets and forecasts, and coordinating contributors and decisions across several teams without direct line-management authority;

  • Experience in consulting or customer-facing delivery is an advantage; a project management qualification such as PMP or PRINCE2 is welcome;

  • Fluent business English and professional fluency in German (at least C1-level).

Your benefits

At NVISO, we care. We are committed to offering you a highly competitive remuneration package including financial and non-financial components:

  • Working and learning from the best people in the European cyber security industry. We have multiple SANS Instructors working at NVISO, our staff has presented at popular hacking conferences (BlackHat, BruCON, OWASP, etc) and all of our technical staff can acquire deep technical security certifications (GSE, GXPN, GREM, GCFA, OSCP, etc);

  • Generous training budget of 10.000 EUR + 10 man days for attending lectures rolling over 2 years;

  • Base salary range (depending on experience and skillset): 70.000 EUR p.a. – 100.000 EUR p.a.;

  • Regular team-building and fun events;

  • Our commitment to coach and counsel you and help you grow; each employee receives a personal coach within the team, whose role is to ensure your well-being and helps you grow in your career!

  • Flexible working hours and home office possibilities (incl. working abroad weeks within the EU);

  • Business Bike Leasing;

  • BahnCard 50 1st class + public transfer ticket or EGYM WellPass;

  • 30 holidays;

  • Company Pension Scheme;

  • Cool offices in the center of Frankfurt, Munich and Vienna (with BBQ, kicker table, table tennis, playstations, etc.).

Disclaimer for the use of AI tools throughout the application process

Please be aware that the creation and submission of application documents (e.g. CV, cover letter, case studies, etc.) using AI-powered tools is only permitted to a limited extent.

Our expectations:

  • Application documents must authentically reflect your own qualifications, personality, and motivation.

  • The use of AI for supportive purposes (e.g. spell-checking, improving wording) is acceptable.

  • Fully generated application documents created by AI without personal adaptation or review are not permitted.

  • Under no circumstances may NVISO information, data, or documents be uploaded to or processed by external AI tools.

We reserve the right to exclude applications from the selection and interview process that are clearly created primarily or exclusively by AI and show no recognizable personal input.

The purpose of this policy is to ensure a fair and transparent recruitment process and to obtain an authentic impression of our applicants.

About the Company:

Tools for Humanity (TFH) designs and builds technology behind World. World is building a real human network designed to accelerate people in the age of AI. As bots and autonomous agents reshape the internet, people, institutions, and applications need a trusted way to confirm who is a real human while preserving privacy. The TFH and World tech stacks make this possible: the Orb verifies real, unique people, World ID proves it privately, and World App puts these capabilities, and more, in people’s hands. Together, they add a human layer to an AI-driven internet.

World is already running at a global scale. More than 17 million people across 160 countries have verified with World ID, and more new Orb verifications take place each week. World App is already among the most used wallets globally. Developers are integrating World ID to build safer online experiences and create spaces where real people can participate, earn, and be recognized in ways AI simply can’t replicate.

Founded in 2019, TFH has more than 400 people across hardware, software, AI, cryptography, mobile engineering, and global operations. Our teams come from OpenAI, Tesla, SpaceX, Apple, Google, Stripe, Meta, Coinbase, Palantir and MIT Media Lab. We’re backed by leading investors, including a16z, Khosla Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Blockchain Capital, Variant, Tiger Global, and Coinbase Ventures, as well as prominent operators and founders across fintech and AI.

TFH and World have been featured on the cover of TIME Magazine, highlighted in Fast Company’s Next 5 in Fintech, and explored in a Bloomberg deep dive. The New York Times, Bankless and TechCrunch have all recognized our collective progress in identity, cryptography, AI, and global-scale hardware deployment. Our leadership is also named to the Time AI 100. Learn more about the newest product launches from our Liftoff event.

About the Team

We are building a planet‑scale biometric recognition system that will serve more than a billion users and enable them to become part of the World protocol. We use cutting-edge Machine Learning models deployed on custom hardware to enable high-quality image acquisition, identification, and fraud prevention, all while requiring minimal user interaction.

We are building a biometric recognition and fraud detection engine that works on the 1bn people scale. Therefore, its performance needs to outperform all the current recognition technologies. We leverage our powerful custom-made iris recognition and presentation attack detection device, the Orb, combined with the latest research from the field of AI and Deep Learning.


To reach our next milestone—continuous, trustworthy ML innovation across millions of edge devices—we’re hiring a Senior ML Platform & Ops Engineer to own the ML lifecycle from data to device. You’ll design and operate production-grade pipelines that transform state-of-the-art ML research into deployed models with clear telemetry, rollback, and reproducibility. If you thrive on building self‑service platforms that turn research ideas into reliable, observable production systems, we’d love to meet you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate reliable, observable infrastructure for training, evaluation, telemetry ingestion, and deployment.

  • Maintain CI/CD workflows and automated pipelines.

  • Edge‑aware rollout services with staged deployment, A/B experimentation and instant rollback across Orbs, Orb Mini and Mobile Apps.

  • Develop secure APIs and backend services that expose governed datasets and model artefacts at scale.

  • Implement automated checks, drift detection, and alerting for real-time model monitoring.

  • Champion best practices in data lineage, reproducibility, privacy‑by‑design, security and secure edge delivery.

  • Collaborate across ML research, product, and firmware teams to streamline delivery and feedback loops.

About You

  • 5+ years building ML infrastructure, data platforms, or production ML systems at scale.

  • Track record of delivering platforms and CI/CD pipelines used daily by ML or data teams.

  • Hands-on experience running large-scale training on multi-tenant GPU clusters to maximize throughput and reliability.

  • You’ve built versioned dataset & lineage systems with slice-level provenance and governed access, making every model reproducible to the exact data, features, code, and config used.

  • Deep understanding of containerisation (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes/EKS) plus Infrastructure‑as‑Code (Terraform/CDK/Cloudformation).

  • Strong backend engineering skills in Python and/or Go; you value clean, maintainable code.

  • Deep understanding of modern CI/CD, model packaging, and observability practices.

  • Comfortable operating production systems, defining SLAs, and handling rollout or incident workflows.

  • Comfortable using modern Agentic AI development

About the Company:

Tools for Humanity (TFH) designs and builds technology behind World. World is building a real human network designed to accelerate people in the age of AI. As bots and autonomous agents reshape the internet, people, institutions, and applications need a trusted way to confirm who is a real human while preserving privacy. The TFH and World tech stacks make this possible: the Orb verifies real, unique people, World ID proves it privately, and World App puts these capabilities, and more, in people’s hands. Together, they add a human layer to an AI-driven internet.

World is already running at a global scale. More than 17 million people across 160 countries have verified with World ID, and more new Orb verifications take place each week. World App is already among the most used wallets globally. Developers are integrating World ID to build safer online experiences and create spaces where real people can participate, earn, and be recognized in ways AI simply can’t replicate.

Founded in 2019, TFH has more than 400 people across hardware, software, AI, cryptography, mobile engineering, and global operations. Our teams come from OpenAI, Tesla, SpaceX, Apple, Google, Stripe, Meta, Coinbase, Palantir and MIT Media Lab. We’re backed by leading investors, including a16z, Khosla Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Blockchain Capital, Variant, Tiger Global, and Coinbase Ventures, as well as prominent operators and founders across fintech and AI.

TFH and World have been featured on the cover of TIME Magazine, highlighted in Fast Company’s Next 5 in Fintech, and explored in a Bloomberg deep dive. The New York Times, Bankless and TechCrunch have all recognized our collective progress in identity, cryptography, AI, and global-scale hardware deployment. Our leadership is also named to the Time AI 100. Learn more about the newest product launches from our Liftoff event.

About the team

The AI & Biometrics team at Tools for Humanity owns the machine learning systems behind the World Network. Our iris and face recognition systems, our anti-spoofing pipeline, and the models running on the Orb and on phones are what make Proof of Personhood actually work at scale.

Within the Face team, we develop systems for face verification, uniqueness and duplicate detection, presentation attack detection, and supporting capabilities such as face detection, image quality assessment, occlusion detection, pose estimation, and others that allow these systems to operate reliably in real-world conditions.

Our work spans the full machine learning lifecycle: defining data-collection and labeling requirements, curating datasets, conducting applied computer-vision research, training and evaluating models, adversarial testing, supporting deployment, investigating production behavior, and monitoring performance after release.

The problems we work on are grounded in real-world conditions. Our systems must handle variation in cameras, lighting, pose, image quality, occlusion, user behavior, and attack methods. They must also operate within strict latency and memory budgets and interact with privacy-preserving systems (Anonymized Multi-Party Computation) that compare users against a growing identity set. At our scale, small regressions can have a meaningful impact, so evaluation, operating-point selection, and production monitoring are central to how we work.

We are pragmatic about our methods. We use deep learning where it provides clear value, classical computer vision and image processing where they are more efficient or reliable, and hybrid approaches when they produce the best system.

The team is well supported. We have a dedicated Mobile subteam that owns deployment to mobile devices, ML Infrastructure and MLOps subteams that own the data pipelines, training clusters, GPU fleet, and much of the underlying tooling, and Face and Iris subteams dedicated to each modality. Face engineers own problem formulation, data requirements, data-quality decisions, model behavior, evaluation methodology, and investigation of model failures for their projects to succeed. We also work closely with the Orb software, Mobile, Proof of Personhood, and Product teams to take ideas to production.

In this role, you will:

  • Own face machine learning projects from initial problem definition through data preparation, experimentation, evaluation, production validation, and monitoring, while partnering with different teams.

  • Improve our core biometric identification and anti-spoofing models, training and iterating on deep learning architectures, losses, and data pipelines, with model size, latency, and memory budgets as first-class design constraints from day one.

  • Use classical computer vision and image processing when they are the right solution, whether as a complete method, a preprocessing stage, a lightweight on-device component, or a diagnostic tool. We are not a deep learning only team, and on-device compute rewards the discipline of using the lighter solution when it fits.

  • Lead independent applied ML initiatives end-to-end: form a written hypothesis, design ablations that isolate variables, run experiments, read results honestly, and know when to ship and when to stop chasing the last percentage point

  • Work directly with face images and datasets: improve collection and labels, inspect difficult samples, identify failure modes, and use those findings to drive model and evaluation changes.

  • Build evaluation pipelines that catch model regressions before they reach production, monitoring that can reveal data drift, score-distribution changes, new attack patterns, cohort-specific regressions, or unexpected model behavior, and improve internal tools for data analysis, model training, evaluation, visualization, red teaming, and monitoring.

  • Read and evaluate relevant computer vision and biometrics research, adapting useful ideas to our systems without treating paper reproduction as the objective.

  • Write design documents, experiment reports, post-launch analysis and technical proposals that remain useful after the project is complete, and others can understand and build on your work.

  • Help shape technical standards across the AI & Biometrics team: evaluation methodology, experimentation discipline, model versioning, monitoring, and across any engineering and scientific standards of the team.

You may be a strong fit if you have:

  • Significant hands-on experience training, evaluating, and shipping deep learning systems for computer vision, with practical understanding of latency and memory constraints.

  • Experience taking an ambiguous machine learning problem and turning it into a structured technical plan.

  • Strong practical knowledge of model training, including data pipelines, augmentations, architecture selection, loss functions, optimization, hyperparameter tuning, and failure analysis.

  • Strong foundations in classical computer vision and image processing, with experience including tools such as OpenCV, NumPy, or equivalent libraries. Fluency in Python and a modern deep-learning framework such as PyTorch.

  • Experience designing evaluations that support real production decisions, including metric selection, operating thresholds, calibration, dataset construction, slicing, leakage prevention, and regression analysis.

  • The ability to write maintainable research and production-quality code.

  • A pragmatic, applied-research mindset: rigorous about experiments, but able to determine when a result is ready to ship and when further optimization has diminishing value.

  • Strong written communication. You define the problem, requirements, assumptions, experiments, success criteria, and conclusions clearly.

  • A collaborative operating style: you work independently without becoming isolated, and you actively share context and knowledge with others, engaging constructively with constraints from neighboring teams rather than treating them as obstacles. We are not looking for a lone wolf, however brilliant.

  • An "in-the-driver's-seat" operating style: you take ownership of problems end-to-end, drive your work forward without waiting for direction, and stand behind your decisions once they are in production.

  • Additional Nice-to-haves :

    • Direct experience with biometric verification/identification; margin-based metric learning losses and their failure modes; presentation attack and liveness detection; or adversarial evaluation of ML systems.

    • Experience with edge optimization and on-device deployment of ML models. Quantization, pruning, distillation, kernel-level optimization, deployment to mobile NPUs, embedded GPUs, microcontrollers, or other constrained targets.

    • Hands-on experience with Rust for high-performance code paths, and the disposition to optimize for speed rather than treat it as someone else's problem.

    • A background in sensors, imaging, computational photography, or camera ISPs.

    • Familiarity with privacy-preserving computation or machine learning systems that interact with secure multi-party computation.

About Black Forest Labs

We're the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX — foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and videos. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we're just getting started.

Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we're scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity.

Why This Role

Our model research moves fast. What's missing is someone accountable for one question: what should our models get better at next, and how will we know when they have?

You’ll lead Product Research, the team between our researchers and the market. You’ll take raw signal from evals, leaderboards, customers and usage data, turn it into a clear measure of where our models stand, and decide which gaps matter most. Your squad of Applied Researchers runs the evals and closes those gaps through post-training. You’ll work closely with Research, Backend, Product and GTM.

What You'll Work On

  • Evaluations. Own the product-facing eval taxonomy, eval strategy, and eval runs.

  • Priorities. Maintain a ranked list of what our models should get better at, built from evals, leaderboards, customer feedback and usage data, and make sure it shapes every research cycle.

  • Applied post-training. Set the priorities for the squad's Applied Researchers, who finetune and run RL to improve our core models and to build variants for specific customers and products. You decide what's worth building, define what success looks like, and check that results hold up with no regressions.

  • Data. Define the data we need to measure and improve our models.

  • Model releases. Co-lead new model releases. You own the quality go/no-go and the capability claims.

What We're Looking For

  • PM experience (product or research) working directly on generative models. You've shaped the model itself rather than building features on top of it.

  • Real technical depth. You can read an eval design and spot what's wrong with it, and you understand finetuning and RL well enough to scope and challenge the work. Researchers take you seriously because of what you know.

  • Strong judgment on trade-offs made with incomplete signal, and the drive to own prioritization end to end.

  • Comfort in an ambiguous, fast-changing research environment, where the right priority shifts as the model and harness evolve.

You've done at least one of these:

  • Defined what a generative model should get better at, and got a research team to act on it.

  • Turned a messy backlog of model weaknesses into ranked priorities that survived contact with a research org. Sources might include bug reports, leaderboard gaps, and customer complaints.

  • Owned evaluation for a model release, including the ship call or the capability claims.

  • Scoped and shipped a finetuned model or variant for a specific customer or product need.

  • Diagnosed a quality regression or plateau and traced it to a data, training, or eval-design cause.

Nice to have: hands-on eval or ML engineering experience, and experience with diffusion or video models.

How We Work Together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. You’ll join us in Freiburg at least 2 days a week (or one full week every other week). We’ll cover reasonable travel costs to make this possible. We think in-person time matters, and we’ve structured things to make it accessible to all. We’ll discuss what this will look like for the role during our interview process.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.

Compensation : 172K-220K base + equity, depending on profile
